task.goal: Rank agents by the number of campaigns they have run

task_results.sql:
SELECT
    created_by_user_id AS created_by,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS campaigns_ran

FROM (
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.organization_id,
  c.branch_id,
  c.name,
  c.description,
  c.status,
  c.starts_at,
  c.ends_at,
  c.source_channel,
  c.created_by_user_id,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  c.goal,
  c.objective,
  c.session_id,
  c.audience_summary,
  c.audience_count,
  c.launch_plan,
  c.launch_local_date,
  c.launch_local_time,
  c.timezone
FROM campaign.campaigns c
WHERE c.organization_id = 1000
  AND c.branch_id = 1000

) campaigns
WHERE TRUE
  AND TRUE
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign.campaign_channels ch WHERE ch.campaign_id = campaigns.id AND ch.organization_id = 1000 AND ch.channel <> 'ppc')
  AND TRUE

  AND status IN ('live','completed','cancelled')
GROUP BY created_by_user_id ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST
